tagline: Your Bridge Between Hawaiʻi and Home

lead.headline: Lowell impacts continue across Hawaiʻi
lead.summary: Tropical-storm conditions, flooding and dangerous surf remain concerns in parts of Hawaiʻi. Readers should continue following official emergency and weather guidance.
lead.why_it_matters: Travel, commuting, coastal activity and outdoor plans may still be affected.

stories.headline: Farrington Highway closure affects West Oʻahu
stories.summary: Honolulu Police reported a closure between Princess Kahanu Avenue and Kaukama Road because hazardous high surf was crossing the roadway.

stories.headline: Habagat affects Luzon and the Visayas
stories.summary: PAGASA reports Southwest Monsoon conditions affecting parts of Luzon and the Visayas, with localized flood and landslide risk during heavier rain.

stories.headline: Welcome to PinoyLink Hawaiʻi
stories.summary: A new Filipino Hawaiʻi community newsroom for local news, Philippines updates, immigration, travel, community, jobs, business and opportunities.
